summary: Frontend-only test of the new 'up to 3 favorite teams + UFC' Summary feature (Aura 2). Verified on mobile viewport (375x667) via Playwright browser automation against the Expo web preview. Backend was not tested per request (server.py unmodified this session). Core favoriting logic (toggleFavorite cap-of-3 + slot-replacement), SUMMARY/2ND/3RD labeling, Summary screen mini-row rendering for 2nd favorite team, UFC mini-row with flame icon, legend/footer copy fix, and general tab regression (Flights/Weather/Device) were all directly verified working. The 3rd-team mini row specifically could not be captured in the SAME screenshot as the 2nd-team mini row + UFC row due to Playwright coordinate-click flakiness on react-native-web Ionicon glyphs (not an app bug -- see rca_of_issue), but was independently confirmed via: (a) code review showing thirdTeam's render block in index.tsx is structurally identical to secondTeam's (same GlanceCard->miniRow pattern, same score/streak logic), and (b) a separate test run where clicking the 3rd row's star successfully promoted it to '3RD' and rendered on Summary as a 'NFL · Ravens' mini row (same code path as the verified 2nd-team row).

integration_issues.flow: Sports tab team logos / ESPN live scores (WallPreview, rotation-row scoreText, Summary mini-row scores)
integration_issues.issue: site.api.espn.com fetches are CORS-blocked in the web preview (documented pre-existing limitation, consistent with prior iterations 10-30). All score/streak text on web preview shows blank fallback ('No game' / 'League · ABBR') instead of live scores. Does not affect the favoriting/UFC feature logic itself; will work on native builds. UFC row correctly falls back to 'No upcoming event' text when getNextUfc() resolves null due to the same CORS block -- this is the CORRECT designed fallback behavior, not a bug.

action_items: No code fixes required for this session's feature. All requested behaviors verified: (1) star cap of 3 with 4th replacing 3rd slot -- confirmed exact behavior (Cardinals=SUMMARY, Falcons=2ND stayed put; Ravens=3RD was replaced by Bills=3RD when a 4th star was tapped). (2) Un-starring works and correctly re-indexes remaining favorites' labels (Ravens moved 3RD->2ND after Falcons was un-starred). (3) Summary screen renders GlanceCard for team1 + mini row for team2 correctly (badge, name/score, 'No game'/streak chip). (4) UFC toggle ON adds a 4th mini row with flame icon + event name or 'No upcoming event' fallback; toggle OFF would remove it (code-reviewed, matches settings.sports.ufc conditional). (5) Legend text on sports.tsx correctly reads 'up to 3' and renders the HTML entity '&' as a literal '&' character on screen (JSX/Babel decodes named entities in text nodes) -- no broken '&' string visible in the rendered UI. (6) Auto-compact heuristic triggered correctly ('Auto-compact · 4+ cards' hint shown) with 3 base cards + 2 extra (1 favorite + UFC) without any crash or visual break.

Consider adding testID attributes to Sports tab interactive elements (team grid cards, star/flame/reorder/remove buttons in rotation rows, UFC toggle) -- none currently exist, which made automated testing rely on fragile pixel-coordinate clicks on Ionicon glyphs rendered as web font characters (not SVG/accessible elements). This is a testability improvement, not a functional bug, but will make future regression testing far more reliable.

The direct-from-client ESPN CORS limitation (espn.ts) remains a long-standing, documented, environment-only issue across many prior iterations -- not new, not a regression from this session, no action needed unless main agent wants to route through the backend proxy for web-preview parity (optional, out of scope for this session).
critical_code_review_comments: matrix.tsx toggleFavorite (line 488-502): cap-of-3 replacement logic 'favorites = [cur[0], cur[1], key]' is correct and matches the exact requirement ('4th replaces the 3rd slot, not 1st/2nd'). Clean, minimal diff from the old cap-of-2 version.

sports.tsx renderRotationRow favLabel logic (line 195-196) correctly derives SUMMARY/2ND/3RD purely from favIndex (array position), so un-starring a middle favorite correctly re-labels the remaining ones by their new index -- verified live (Ravens went 3RD->2ND after Falcons was removed).

index.tsx renderSports(): thirdTeam block (lines 583-633) is a near-exact duplicate of the secondTeam block (532-582) -- only variable names differ (thirdTeam/thirdMeta/score3/streak3/s3live vs second*). This duplication works correctly but is a DRY violation; extracting a shared MiniTeamRow(team, meta, score, streak, live) helper would reduce ~50 lines of copy-paste and reduce future drift risk (e.g. if one block gets a bugfix and the other doesn't).

extraCards / autoCompact calculation (line 365-370) correctly accounts for thirdTeam and ufc in the '4+ cards' heuristic -- verified via screenshot showing 'Auto-compact · 4+ cards' triggered with only 1 favorite + UFC (3 base cards + 2 extra = 5 > 3).

Legend text '&' in sports.tsx line 373 is technically fine (JSX decodes HTML entities in text children via Babel's jsx transform), confirmed rendering as a literal '&' on screen in screenshots -- not a literal '&' string bug as the review request worried about.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of directly-testable behaviors passed (star cap/replacement/unstar/labels, Summary main+2nd-team mini row, UFC mini row, legend/footer copy, tab regression). 3rd-team-simultaneously-with-2nd+UFC in one screenshot not directly captured due to test-tool click flakiness (not an app bug); verified via code symmetry + isolated separate run instead.

seed_data_creation: None -- all state is client-side AsyncStorage (web localStorage), reset with each new browser automation session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT ENVIRONMENT NOTE: each mcp_browser_automation call appears to spin a fresh browser context (localStorage/AsyncStorage does NOT persist across separate tool calls) -- any multi-step flow (e.g. select teams -> star them -> navigate to Summary) MUST happen within a SINGLE script invocation, not split across calls, or all prior state is lost. Also: Ionicons in this react-native-web build render as plain DIVs with an 'ionicons' web-font glyph character (not SVG, not accessible role='button'), so page.locator('svg') finds nothing and text-based locators don't help for icon-only buttons -- pixel-coordinate clicks (page.mouse.click(x,y)) after a get_by_text().bounding_box() lookup work but are occasionally flaky (RN-web touch-responder timing); adding testID props to Sports tab icon buttons would fix this for future runs. Sports tab team grid cards and rotation-row team names both match 'get_by_text(name, exact=True)' -- use .last or .nth() to disambiguate the rotation-row instance from the grid-card instance, otherwise bounding_box() can return a stale/off-screen (negative y) box for the wrong match.
rca_of_issue: Test flakiness RCA (not an app bug): react-native-web renders TouchableOpacity/Pressable star/flame icons as absolutely-positioned DIVs containing an Ionicons web-font glyph character, with no distinguishing DOM attributes (no testID/data-testid present in current code). Playwright's page.mouse.click(x,y) at a fixed pixel coordinate is timing-sensitive -- react-native-web's synthetic responder system sometimes needs a slightly longer dwell or exact hit-target pixel that shifts by 1-2px when adjacent rows re-render after a favorite tag ('SUMMARY'/'2ND'/'3RD') appears/disappears, which can nudge row layout. This caused 2 of ~8 star-tap attempts across the session to silently miss. All core logic was still verified correct through the attempts that did land precisely, and cross-checked via code review of the (symmetric) secondTeam/thirdTeam code paths in index.tsx.
